motivation.mechanism: NativePeerMedia intentionally drops capacity refusals. Newly nonblocking fresh model admission returns Backpressure on transient model mutex contention. motivation.limitation: The controlled defect is established; only a new actual runtime cohort can determine restoration of the observed WT/media scope or resolution of cadence failures.

implementation: Fresh non-data ingress without borrowed packet context recovers model metadata for at most one20ms mix quantum. The original frame and frozen stream/credential/consumer/scene snapshots remain unchanged; no added packet queue or wire retry exists.

If metadata collides after external policy admission, destroy that policy lease before waiting. Reacquire metadata, verify original model/credential, release metadata, then read current policy again; never cache a positive grant through the wait.

Keep the earliest policy/credential IO deadline across all attempts. An expired original is never renewed by a later grant. Already expired task/principal remains Authority; a valid original whose IO lease expires remains Deadline.

Retained/context-bearing/data/held paths retain existing behavior. The original global packet age and all current authorization, audience and IO fences remain; native capacity drop remains explicit when bounded recovery cannot finish.
